title: Objective Measurement of AI Literacy: Development and Validation of the AI Competency Objective Scale (AICOS)
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on developing and validating the AI Competency Objective Scale (AICOS) to measure human AI literacy.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the objective measurement of AI literacy in humans.
